page.title: Artifacts
page.emptyDescription: Pages your agents make for you show here, by project and session. Ask an agent for a report, a deck or design options.
page.errorDescription: {{error}} Your artifacts are safe on this computer.
page.importFailedTitle: The file could not be imported

importFailed.too_large: It is over 5 MiB, the most an artifact holds.
importFailed.unavailable: The agent host can't take it right now. Try again in a moment.

page.deletedDescription: Deleted artifacts stay here for 30 days, then they and every version of them are removed for good.

dialog.title: Title
dialog.eraseDescription_one: Its one version will be removed from this computer. This cannot be undone.
dialog.eraseDescription_other: Its {{count}} versions will be removed from this computer. This cannot be undone.
dialog.deleteDescription: It moves to Recently deleted, where it stays for 30 days.
dialog.unpublishTooDescription: Its link stops working for everyone who has it.

viewer.stoppedDescription: Its process ended. Reload to show it again.

error.notFound: It is no longer in OverBench.
error.unavailable: The agent host can't show it right now. Try again in a moment.

viewer.goneDescription: It stays in Recently deleted for 30 days.
viewer.editingLabel: {{session}} is editing this artifact. Open the session
viewer.placesTip_other: This artifact is open in {{count}} places in OverBench

share.unpublished: Publish this artifact to a link anyone can open.
share.disclosure: Anyone with the link can see this page, which loads its scripts and fonts from public CDNs.
share.needAccount: Connect a Cloudflare account in Settings › Sharing to publish this artifact.
share.unpublishConfirm: The link stops working for everyone. The artifact stays in OverBench.
share.noAccountPublished: Connect the Cloudflare account that published it to change it.
share.otherAccount: This page was published with another Cloudflare account. Connect that account to change it.

failures.invalid_token: Cloudflare refused the API token. Check it in Settings › Sharing.
failures.no_subdomain: The account has no workers.dev subdomain. Choose one in Cloudflare's dashboard.
failures.worker_limit: The account already has {{count}} Workers, the most its plan allows. Unpublish one first.
failures.network: Cloudflare could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
failures.no_account: Connect a Cloudflare account in Settings › Sharing.
failures.other_account: This page was published with another Cloudflare account.
failures.encryption: The system cannot encrypt the API token, so it was not saved.
failures.not_found: The page is no longer on Cloudflare. Publish it again.
failures.unavailable: The agent host did not answer. Try again in a moment.
